source: Module 5-1 gate adapted to workpiece_2 single-view raised-structure geometry
description: Workpiece 2 tabletop-reverse registration uses yaw-constrained point-to-plane ICP. Require jointly: fitness >= 0.45, depth match >= 0.70, and point-to-plane ICP RMSE <= 3 mm. A rejected pose may still be visualized but must not be sent to Planner.
